# add keybase

Add the `keybase` cask — Keybase, the identity/PGP key service with a desktop client and encrypted git — to the Homebrew toolset, presumably to publish and manage the GPG key that signs commits. The original reference is the [cask page](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/keybase).
